History of Monaco

Digitized Documents on the History of Monaco

Part of BYU's searchable Digital Collections.

From the 
Archivio di Stato di Torino
 (Italy) and the 
Archives départementales des Alpes-Maritimes
 in Nice (France).

See 
use instructions
.

(1191-1849; French, Italian and Latin facsimiles)

Transcribed Documents from the Archives départementales des Alpes-Maritimes

From the French regional archive in Nice.

(1662-1945; documents in Latin, Italian and French)

Plan de Monaco

Map of Monaco made in the 18th-century.

(1764; zoomable map)

Hymne Monégasque

National anthem of Monaco. Adopted in 1848.

(Monegasque and French with English translation; 1848)

Treaty of Turin

Treaty in which Monaco and surrounding territories were ceded to France.

(French; March 24, 1860)

Treaties and Bilateral Agreements

Collection of bilateral treaties involving Monaco.

(French; 1861-present)

Treaties and Multilateral Agreements

Collection of multilateral treaties involving Monaco.

(French; 1906-present)

Franco-Monégasque Treaties

Establishing relations of France with the Principality of Monaco (with exchange of letters)

(1918; French and English)

Monegasque Royals

Collection of footage documenting the royals, including the arrival of Grace Kelley, the imperial ball, weddings and funerals

Compiled by 
British Pathe

(1949-1969; English interface; videos)

Constitution of the Principality of Monaco

Modern constitution of Monaco. Also available in 
French
.

(English; April 2, 1962)

New Treaty with France

Treaty establishing modern relations between France and Monaco.

(French with English translation; October 24, 2002)

The Principality of Monaco’s application for membership of the Council of Europe

Monaco's application to the Council of Europe.

(8 April 2004; English)

Act of 12 July 2007 Concerning Education

Law concerning education which mandated the study of the Monégasque language in schools, among many other provisions.

(French; July 12, 2007)

Tax agreements signed by Monaco

Collection of tax and fiscal treaties involving Monaco.

(French; 2010-2012)

Collection of historical maps of Monaco.
